_meta.purpose: Reference databases the project has approved for mima-taxa-profiling. build_command.py warns when --reference-path is not listed.
_meta.status: Proposed by the project owner (Rafael); pending confirmation by the supervisor, Dr Jiang.
_meta.how_to_add: Add an object to 'databases' with the directory, release, scope and the read lengths that have databaseNmers.kmer_distrib files. Only add a database after the lab approves it.

databases.name: GTDB release 95, Kraken2 and Bracken
databases.scope: Bacteria and archaea in gut and stool metagenomes
databases.notes: Dated 2020: newer species may be missing. GTDB names and ranks differ from NCBI taxonomy. No eukaryotes or viruses.

needs_approval.fungi_and_protozoa: An NCBI PlusPF-type database (standard plus protozoa and fungi) would be needed; not on the approved list.
needs_approval.viruses: Kraken2 virome calls from gut shotgun data are weak: needs a dedicated approach, not an approved database.
